ui.review: Successful beginLogin publishes succeeded and removes its listener/clears the timeout; it does not invoke invalidate there. Later invalidate/close/replacement can abort the operation. Controlled native-wire cases leave the caller operation un-aborted, so an explicit UI cancellation is not required for early stream dispose.
